summary: Continuity and nondegeneracy are part of Attached. For the trace identity, the Hecke polynomials at w and w̄ are dual (heckeSplit_dual); passing to the limit along Frobenii approaching g gives c₀(r(g))·c_k(r(g^c)) = c₁(r(g))·cycInv(g)^k for the coefficients of characteristic polynomials (|n| = k + 1), which is the trace identity.

steps.claim: r is continuous and has nondegenerate trace form (the first two clauses of Attached); for each g the trace identity is proved below.
steps.lean:
⟨hr.1, hr.2.1, fun g ↦ by
  cases' e : Fintype.card n with k; simp_all [card_eq_zero_iff]
  have := tendsto_nhds_unique ((hr.tendsto_charpoly_coeff g 0).mul (have o :=
      (Homeomorph.mk ⟨_, _, conjGal_conjGal, conjGal_conjGal⟩).isOpenEmbedding; conjGal_conjGal g ▸
      Attached.tendsto_charpoly_coeff (P := (Q <| star ·)) ⟨hr.1, hr.2.1, o.isOpenMap, (hr.2.2.2
      · · |> mostFrobenii_push o star |>.mono fun y B x e ↦ B ⟨_, _, x, by simp [y.prime_q],
      y.isPlaceOver.conjPlace_star, by simpa [← e] using y.isFrob.conjPlace_conjGal⟩ (by simp) e _
      rfl)⟩ _ k)) (((hr.tendsto_charpoly_coeff g 1).mul (tendsto_mostFrobeniiAt
    (cycInv j _ _ · ^ k))).congr' (Filter.mem_inf_of_left (eventually_mostFrobenii (he.2.and
    (.and (eventually_notMem_star_notMem j ∅) (star_injective.tendsto_cofinite he.2))) fun y a ↦ by
    obtain ⟨⟨a, c, s, x⟩, _, d, u, z⟩ := a.1 y.prime_q, a.2.2 (by simp [y.prime_q])
    have := (heckeSplit_dual a · · c (v_uniformizer _))
    simp [smul_left_inj, smul_smul, he.1, heckeGL_zero ((mem_sphericalAt_iff _).1 d) ▸ this 0,
      cycInv_eq_of_isFrob y, Nat.choose, *] at *
    grind)))
  cases k.even_or_odd <;> simp_all [trace_eq_neg_charpoly_nextCoeff, nextCoeff,
    field, coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, by simpa using (r g⁻¹).1.charpoly_inv]⟩

steps.claim: Case split on |n|: if |n| = 0 the identity holds trivially; it remains to treat |n| = k + 1.

steps.claim: At such y: f is spherical at w and w̄ with Hecke polynomials Q_w and Q_{w̄}, and the uniformiser data at w.

steps.claim: Hecke duality at a split place: the translate by the scalar ϖ_w at w of the i-th Hecke operator at w̄ is the (|n| − i)-th Hecke operator at w (heckeSplit_dual).
Applying this to f (T_0 = identity on spherical vectors, heckeGL_zero) and comparing coefficients with cycInv(frob) = q_w (cycInv_eq_of_isFrob): Q_w(0)·Q_{w̄}(k) = Q_w(1)·q_w^k.

steps.claim: The remaining equalities close by arithmetic.

With |n| = k + 1: tr r(g^c) = −c_k(r(g^c)) and tr r(g⁻¹) = −c₁(r(g))/c₀(r(g)) (the characteristic polynomial of r(g)⁻¹), for k even and odd; so the identity of step 1.2 is tr r(g^c) = cycInv(g)^k·tr r(g⁻¹) = cycInv(g)^{|n|−1}·tr r(g⁻¹).
